# CIRRUS

> CIRRUS is NSF NCAR's Cloud Native platform for always-on research workloads: two Kubernetes clusters (NCAR Mesa Lab and NWSC) run by the CIRRUS team. Workloads are packaged as containers, described with Helm charts or Kubernetes YAML in git, and deployed by Argo CD. It complements NCAR's HPC systems rather than replacing them.
